reviews.title: Great Budget SSD Upgrade for Older Systems
reviews.comment: This SSD installed easily and worked right away in my laptop. It’s a great upgrade from a traditional hard drive — boot times are much faster and everything feels more responsive. Speeds are solid for a SATA drive, and it runs quietly and cool. Perfect for giving an older PC a noticeable performance boost at a good price.
reviews.author: Pepe DI

reviews.title: Good budget SSD
reviews.comment: This SSD has the same features as the more expensive solid state drives and it's a great deal for the money. It's fast and was easy to install. Windows had no problems picking it up, so there's no compatibility issues and it seems reliable. I installed it in my niece's first gaming PC and it's been running for a year.
reviews.author: Thomas Nutter
